meta.name: study-quiz
meta.description: Quiz & assessment sub-skill (orchestrated by study-assistant; also usable standalone). Use when the learner uploads past papers/questions ("真题", 历年试卷, 样题), wants AI to search for school-style questions, asks to be tested ("出题" "考我" "测验" "模拟题" "来套模拟卷"), submits answers for grading, or asks to review mistakes. Maintains one course-level global question bank, prioritizes uploaded questions over web-sourced material, generates MathJax-capable interactive HTML quizzes, grades answers, updates mastery, and maintains the mistake book.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据真题生成互动测验并自动批改
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果学生需要从历年试卷生成测验并追踪掌握情况
copy.tagline_en: Generate interactive quizzes from past papers and auto-grade answers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if students need to create quizzes from past exams and track mastery

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你上传的真题或搜索到的题目生成交互式 HTML 测验，批改你的答案，记录错题，并更新你的掌握程度。
howto.when: 当你上传真题、要求出题考你、提交答案要求批改，或请求复习错题时触发。

say.text: 帮我出一套关于微积分的模拟卷。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份 HTML 测验并打开。

say.text: 批改我上传的答案照片。
say.note: Claude 会识别手写答案并逐题批改。
Claude 会从错题本中抽取题目重新测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate interactive HTML quizzes based on your uploaded past papers or web-sourced questions, grade your answers, record mistakes, and update your mastery level.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload past papers, ask to be tested, submit answers for grading, or request mistake review.

say_en.text: Generate a mock exam on calculus.
say_en.note: Claude will create an HTML quiz and open it.
Claude will transcribe handwriting and grade each question.
Claude will pick unresolved mistakes and re-ask them.
